analogy.rationale: DPEP1 is a membrane dipeptidase highly expressed in kidney and gut epithelium but not a transcriptional regulator; its inhibition by cilastatin-like drugs produces minimal mRNA changes in these cell lines, so the expected response is essentially none. Other protease/peptidase inhibitor classes are the closest analogs but still share little transcriptional program.
